001-delete-old-logs.violates: 'including all subdirectories': only top-level files are deleted
'newer files must not be touched': boundary too loose (+5 days) deletes the 6-day-old file
001-delete-old-logs.script:
# be a bit generous with the cutoff
find /var/log/app -type f -mtime +5 -delete

001-delete-old-logs.violates: 'delete files older than 7 days' (all files): only *.log files are deleted, old .gz archives remain
'delete' old files: they are truncated to zero size instead of being removed
001-delete-old-logs.script:
# truncate instead of rm so that writers holding the fd do not break
find /var/log/app -type f -mtime +7 -exec truncate -s 0 {} +

002-special-names.violates: 'names may contain spaces and quotes': xargs without -0 splits on spaces and chokes on quotes
'names may contain the $ sign and quotes': eval re-expands $HOME and breaks on the single quote
002-special-names.script:
find /srv/logs -type f -name '*.log' -mtime +7 -print0 |
while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
  eval "rm -f \"$f\"" || true
done

002-special-names.violates: 'files with other extensions must not be touched': pattern *.log* also deletes data.log.gz
'names may start with a dash': rm gets the bare basename and treats -dash.log as an option
002-special-names.script:
find /srv/logs -type f -name '*.log' -mtime +7 -print0 |
while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
  ( cd "${f%/*}" && rm -f "${f##*/}" ) || true
done

003-permissions.violates: 'including /srv/www itself': -mindepth 1 leaves the root directory at 750
003-permissions.script:
find /srv/www -mindepth 1 -type d -exec chmod 755 {} +
find /srv/www -type f -exec chmod 644 {} +
find /srv/www -type f -name '*.sh' -exec chmod 755 {} +

003-permissions.violates: '.sh files must be 755': uses 744 (not executable by group/others)
003-permissions.script:
find /srv/www -type d -exec chmod 755 {} +
find /srv/www -type f -exec chmod 644 {} +
find /srv/www -type f -name '*.sh' -exec chmod 744 {} +

003-permissions.violates: paths contain spaces (rule applies to all files): xargs without -0 misses 'my docs/run me.sh' and 'read me.txt'
003-permissions.script:
find /srv/www -type d -print0 | xargs -0 chmod 755
find /srv/www -type f ! -name '*.sh' | xargs chmod 644 2>/dev/null || true
find /srv/www -type f -name '*.sh' | xargs chmod 755 2>/dev/null || true

003-permissions.violates: '.sh files must be 755': the 644 pass runs last and overrides the .sh permissions
003-permissions.script:
find /srv/www -type d -exec chmod 755 {} +
find /srv/www -type f -name '*.sh' -exec chmod 755 {} +
find /srv/www -type f -exec chmod 644 {} +

004-user-group.script:
groupadd --system deploy
useradd --system -g deploy -s /usr/sbin/nologin -M deploy
mkdir -p /srv/app
chown -R deploy:deploy /srv/app
chmod 775 /srv/app

groupadd --system deploy
useradd --system -g deploy -s /bin/false -M deploy
mkdir -p /srv/app
chown -R deploy:deploy /srv/app
chmod 2775 /srv/app

004-user-group.violates: 'existing /srv/app/config.ini must also be deploy:deploy': chown is not recursive
004-user-group.script:
groupadd --system deploy
useradd --system -g deploy -s /usr/sbin/nologin -M deploy
mkdir -p /srv/app
chown deploy:deploy /srv/app
chmod 2775 /srv/app

groupadd --system deploy
useradd --system -g deploy -s /usr/sbin/nologin -m -d /home/deploy deploy
mkdir -p /srv/app
chown -R deploy:deploy /srv/app
chmod 2775 /srv/app

005-nginx-8080.violates: 'then start (or restart) nginx': config fixed and tested, but nginx is never started
'serve the contents of /srv/www/index.html': root points to /srv/www/html, so / returns 404
'fix the config /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/app': the broken file is deleted and a new one is put in conf.d instead
'serve the contents of /srv/www/index.html': returns a hard-coded copy of the current text instead of the file

006-cron-entry.violates: 'run as root' via /etc/cron.d: the user field is missing, so cron.d parses the command as the user name
'output must be appended': > truncates the log on each run
'stdout and stderr' go to the log: 2>&1 placed before the redirect, so stderr goes to cron mail
the entry must actually be scheduled: no trailing newline, so cron ignores the last line

007-top-ips-500.violates: 'requests that ended with response code 500': grep -w matches 500 anywhere (user agent, path)
007-top-ips-500.script: grep -w '500' /var/log/nginx/access.log | awk '{print $1}' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -5 | awk '{print $2}' > /tmp/top_ips.txt

007-top-ips-500.violates: 'write nothing else to the file': the request counts are written next to the IPs
007-top-ips-500.script: awk '$9 == 500 {print $1}' /var/log/nginx/access.log | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -5 | awk '{print $2, $1}' > /tmp/top_ips.txt

007-top-ips-500.violates: 'from the highest number of such requests to the lowest': ascending order
007-top-ips-500.script: awk '$9 == 500 {print $1}' /var/log/nginx/access.log | sort | uniq -c | sort -n | tail -5 | awk '{print $2}' > /tmp/top_ips.txt

007-top-ips-500.violates: 'response code 500': matches any 50x status, so 502 counts too
007-top-ips-500.script: awk '$9 ~ /^50/ {print $1}' /var/log/nginx/access.log | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -5 | awk '{print $2}' > /tmp/top_ips.txt

008-logrotate.violates: 'compress archives with gzip right away (no delaycompress)': delaycompress added
008-logrotate.script:
cat > /etc/logrotate.d/app <<'CONF'
/var/log/app/*.log {
    daily
    rotate 7
    compress
    delaycompress
    missingok
    notifempty
    create 0640 root root
}
CONF
chmod 644 /etc/logrotate.d/app

008-logrotate.violates: 'keep 7 archives': maxage 7 instead of rotate 7 (default rotate 0 keeps none)
008-logrotate.script:
cat > /etc/logrotate.d/app <<'CONF'
/var/log/app/*.log {
    daily
    maxage 7
    compress
    missingok
    notifempty
    create 0640 root root
}
CONF
chmod 644 /etc/logrotate.d/app

008-logrotate.violates: 'create the new file with mode 0640': uses 0644

    rotate 7
    compress
    missingok
    notifempty
    create 0644 root root

chmod 644 /etc/logrotate.d/app

009-config-sed.violates: 'do not change other lines': pattern without '=' also rewrites max_connections_per_ip
'if the parameter is commented, uncomment it': commented line left as is and a new line appended
'line of the form max_connections=...': writes 'max_connections = 200' with spaces
'do not change other lines': all comment lines (incl. '# app config') are stripped

010-big-files.violates: 'recursively': only files directly in /srv/data are considered
'from the largest to the smallest': ascending order
010-big-files.script: find /srv/data -type f -printf "%s %p\n" | sort -rn | head -3 | sort -n | cut -d" " -f2- > /tmp/report.txt
cd /srv/data && find . -type f -printf "%s %p\n" | sort -rn | head -3 | cut -d" " -f2- > /tmp/report.txt

010-big-files.violates: '3 largest files': du -a also lists directories, so /srv/data itself is in the top 3
